Subject: Catalog listing + regional pricing / SLA questions

Hi Sarah, Tomasz —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Quick follow-up items we discussed for the partner catalog listing and co-sell packaging across regions (US and EU initial scope):

- Pricing matrix: need to confirm list vs. discount levels per region (we discussed EMEA uplift for data residency).
- SLA language: customers will ask about cross-region failover and our combined SLA; we should clarify who owns the response-runbook for inference outages.
- SSO / SCIM for field enablement: one-click provisioning is required for marketplace demo accounts.
- OTLP compatibility note: please confirm supported exporter versions for our agent bundle.

I've attached a first-pass SOW and a regional pricing spreadsheet to make the asks concrete. Could you each take a look and call out any legal/ops blockers this week? If helpful we can schedule a short ops-only sync with AcmeCloud (our implementation partner).

Next steps I propose:
- Sarah/Tomasz: mark changes in the pricing matrix by Wed 7/18
- Internal: Ben / Jasmine / Marissa will produce a single-page "co-sell invoice path" diagram by Thu 7/19
- Ops sync with AcmeCloud if either of you want an implementation readiness review (I can coord)

Thanks — appreciate the speedy turnaround.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Tel: +1 415-555-0142

Laura —

Thanks for the summary and the artifacts, this is super helpful. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Pricing: we can commit to list pricing for US and EU with a fixed partner discount tier. I'll run the EMEA uplift ask with pricing ops, but that may add ~2 business days.
2) SLA: Datadog is comfortable owning monitoring & alerting for our joint agent and providing a 99.9% availability commitment for the telemetry path; for model inference runtime SLAs we'll need a joint statement. Can Redwood supply a short failover playbook?
3) OTLP: we currently support OTLP proto v0.16+ and will validate exporter compatibility with your agent bundle.

I'll mark the spreadsheet with comments by EOD 7/18 and propose an ops-only sync on 7/19 if that works.

Best,
Sarah Lim
Partnerships, Strategic Alliances | Datadog

Laura / Sarah —

Appreciate the clear asks. From Grafana's POV: 
- Marketplace listing: we require a short technical blurb, a verified integration badge (we can fast-track once your connector passes our QA matrix), and a joint logo bundle. Marissa — can you share the integration blurb by tomorrow?
- Pricing: we do not typically handle partner discounts on behalf of marketplaces; we'll approve a recommended price and leave discounting to the vendor.
- SLA: Grafana will own dashboarding availability and provide guidance for runbooks, but we are not able to co-sign inference SLAs for third-party compute. A joint "resp matrix" (who owns what) is acceptable for the co-sell page.

I've added AcmeCloud to loop for implementation concerns — they run several regional installs and can validate the deployment pattern.

Regards,
Tomasz Nowak
Head of Integrations | Grafana Labs
tomasz@grafana.com
